text:
Priya: Heads-up — ZetaHealth wants a performance POC this week. requirement: chat 99p <= 250ms, sustained 20 qps, short bursts to 200 qps for ~30s. HIPAA + KMS/HSM. Need runbook + cost estimate. Can we support on Dedicated or Private? :eyes:
Sam: We can do Dedicated pools or Private VPC. For those tail numbers we'll need GPU-backed instances (A100 or H100). Are they okay with model sharding / quantization?
Maya (Zeta): They prefer model zeta-chat-13b-qa (we onboarded it) and want minimal quality loss — prefer q4_0 if possible. KMS is mandatory.
Alex: Quick notes — 20 qps sustained at 13b is small but bursts to 200 qps means autoscale + burst capacity. We should test warm vs cold, KV cache hit rates, and prefix caching.
Sam: Proposed test plan (short):
- Warmup: 5k requests to populate KV cache
- Sustained run: 30 minutes @ 20 qps (avg latency, p50/p95/p99)
- Burst cycles: 6x 30s bursts to 200 qps spaced 2min apart
- Concurrency mix: 8 concurrent connections during bursts
- Sequence length: median 64 tokens, max 256 tokens
- Model variants: baseline fp16, q4_0 quantized
- HW: H100 (preferred) and A100 fallback

Sam: Example load command we’ll use (wrk-like):
```
wrk -t8 -c200 -d30s -s zeta_chat.lua --latency http://redwood-poc.internal/generate
```
Priya: ETA on run and estimate? Also pricing ask: customer asked for 6 months of reserved vs monthly burst — need numbers.
Ethan: I can draft costs. Rough calc: Dedicated pool (1x 8x H100) to hit peak headroom for 200 qps with q4_0 — estimate ~ $18k/month reserved; burst (on-demand) add ~ $3k/month depending on cloud. I'll validate.
Alex: Also add infra ops cost for private deployment + KMS/HSM integration (~one-time setup 2-3 weeks of eng + security review).
Maya: Security blocker — they require HSM-backed key wrapping and yearly SOC2 evidence. Can Redwood do customer-managed KMS in Private?
Sam: Yes for Private we support customer KMS via BYOK; HSM connector can be done but needs security signoff. That’s on the security checklist.
Priya: Can you get a perf delta estimate between fp16 and q4_0? Zeta cares about quality regression.
Sam: From previous similar 13b model runs: q4_0 reduces latency by ~22% and reduces token cost ~40%, p99 improves by ~15-20% after warm cache. Quality checks: small regressions on rare tokens — recommend running eval set (we should ask Zeta for 200 representative prompts).
Priya: Good — ask them for eval corpus. Also need acceptance criteria: p99 <= 250ms, success rate >= 99.5%, and model quality (top-1 exact match) degrade < 2% vs fp16.
Maya: We'll provide 250 prompts and a holdout 200 for acceptance. 250 includes long tails.
Ethan: I'll attach a pricing sketch (high level):
- Option A (Reserved Dedicated): 1x 8xH100 pool with 99% reserved uptime: $18,000/mo + 1x setup fee $12k + KMS integration $8k (one-time)
- Option B (Private Self-hosted): Platform license $10k/mo + infra costs (customer) + HSM connector professional services $15k (one-time)
- Option C (Hosted + burst): Base hosted at usage rates (~$0.04/token equiv) with burst nodes priced per-hour — estimate $21k/mo if heavy bursts included
(These are placeholders — will refine after we pick hardware and expected token volume)
Priya: Next steps — Sam run the plan on H100, gather p50/p95/p99 for both fp16 and q4_0. Ethan finalize cost ranges. Alex coordinate scheduling + security kickoff. I’ll sync with Zeta to send eval prompts.
Sam: I’ll start bench tomorrow 09:00 PT. quick note on metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU usage, GPU utilization, KV cache hit ratio, cold-start distribution, and error rates (429/5xx).
OpsBot: Deploy job #4572 queued on redwood-poc-eu for H100 test — ETA 30m.
Priya: Awesome — please post results to this thread when done. If we hit p99 < 250ms on q4_0, include a short note on quality delta with example prompts that regressed.
Sam: Will do. tagging @Ethan for pricing follow-up. :thumbsup:
Ethan: Got it — will post a draft cost doc by EOD today.
Alex: Also add a rollback plan: if q4_0 causes >2% quality drop, we serve fp16 for enterprise routes and route non-critical traffic to q4_0 for cost saving.
Maya: That works for us. timeline: want results and contract draft by next Wed.
Priya: Great — thanks team.
Sam: Posting initial warm-run summary here after test (results will be concise):
- Warm cache run (20 qps, fp16): p50 32ms, p95 140ms, p99 280ms, GPU util 68%
- Warm cache run (20 qps, q4_0): p50 26ms, p95 110ms, p99 225ms, GPU util 52%
- Burst (200 qps, q4_0, 30s): p50 30ms, p95 190ms, p99 420ms (cold tails observed during ingress)
Sam: Observations: q4_0 meets their p99 <250ms for sustained 20 qps. Bursts push p99 over target due to cold path and short-lived instance spin-ups. Autoscaler warm pools or pre-warmed burst nodes recommended.
Priya: That’s golden. Can you save full logs + a tiny summary slide? I’ll send to Zeta and tie to pricing options.
Sam: Yep — uploading artifacts to /poc/zetahealth/5098765432/results.tar.gz (contains raw logs, scripts, and perf dashboard snapshot).
Ethan: Updated cost note: to guarantee burst SLO (pre-warmed capacity) add ~$4k/mo to reserved pool. I'll reflect in final.
Alex: I'll schedule the security kickoff with Zeta for tomorrow 10am PT.
Maya: Confirmed — see you then. Thanks all.
Priya: Closing loop — once we have the final cost + security ok, we can move to contract. :white_check_mark:
